_note: Defines which fixtures form a single end-to-end chain (init -> ticket -> pr on the same repo) versus a standalone fixture that only exercises one stage. The end-to-end success rate is computed over chains, not individual fixtures -- a chain only counts as a successful end-to-end run if every fixture in it currently passes.

chains.description: 01-greenfield (init) -> 02-ticket-new-page (ticket, Table extension) -> 03-pr-manage-users (pr, fail-fix-pass + override + adversarial challenge)
05-landing-init (init) -> 06-landing-ticket (ticket, no new components needed) -> 07-landing-pr-clean (pr, zero-blocker clean pass)

standalone.description: Init-only fixture (dimension classification + source reconciliation). Not yet extended into a ticket/pr chain, so it is reported separately rather than counted toward end-to-end chain success.
